questions.question_text:
A mortgage of $\$165\,000$ at $9\%$ p.a. compounded monthly ($r=0.0075$) is repaid with monthly payments of $\$1700$.
Evaluate the model balance $A_{180}$ after $15$ years ($180$ months), to the nearest cent, hypothetically continuing full end-of-month payments even after the loan is paid off.

options.why: Ignored the negative sign in the hypothetical model balance.
Used annual compounding over $15$ years and subtracted only $15$ repayments: $165\,000(1.09)^{15}-1700(15)$.

questions.solution_text:
$r=0.0075, n=180$, with repayments at the end of each month.
$A_0=165\,000$
$A_1=165\,000(1.0075)-1700$
$A_2=165\,000(1.0075)^2-1700(1.0075)-1700$
$A_{180}=165\,000(1.0075)^{180}-[1700+1700(1.0075)+\dots+1700(1.0075)^{179}]$
The repayment series has $a=1700$, $R=1.0075$ and $180$ terms.
$A_{180}=165\,000(1.0075)^{180}-1700\left[\dfrac{(1.0075)^{180}-1}{0.0075}\right]$
Keeping full precision until the final rounding gives $A_{180}=-\$10\,012.67$.
This is a model balance from hypothetically continuing full payments. The actual loan is paid off before $15$ years.

questions.question_text:
A business loan of $\$80\,000$ is repaid in quarterly instalments of $\$3450$ over $8$ years.
Find the total amount paid over the life of the loan.

options.why: Multiplied repayment by 8 years instead of 32 quarters.
Added the initial principal to the total payments.
Calculated total interest instead of total amount paid.

questions.question_text:
A personal loan of $\$55\,000$ is fully repaid with $60$ monthly payments of $\$1140$.
How much total interest was charged?

options.why: Reported the total amount paid rather than the interest charged.
Multiplied monthly repayment by 10 instead of computing total payments minus principal.
Calculated the average annual interest by dividing total interest by 5 years ($13\,400 \div 5$).

questions.question_text:
A loan of $\$25\,000$ at $6\%$ p.a. compounded monthly ($r=0.005$) has monthly repayments of $\$400$.
Find the balance owing after $24$ months, to the nearest cent.

options.why: Subtracted 24 repayments directly from principal without compounding interest.
Computed compound growth of principal but neglected repayments.

questions.question_text: For a $\$35\,000$ loan where $A_{36}=\$18\,483.69$ after $36$ monthly repayments of $\$650$, calculate the total interest charged during the first $36$ months.

options.why: Reported principal reduction instead of interest charged.
Reported total amount paid rather than interest.
Subtracted the remaining balance directly from total payments instead of computing total payments minus principal reduction.

questions.question_text:
A couple takes out a $\$250\,000$ mortgage at $7.2\%$ p.a. compounded monthly ($r=0.006$) with monthly payments of $\$2000$.
What is the balance owing at the end of $10$ years ($120$ months), to the nearest cent?

options.why: Assumed exactly half the principal has been repaid.
Subtracted total payments $120 \times 2000 = 240\,000$ directly from principal.
Computed compound growth of principal but neglected repayments.
